description: This Clustered Column chart allows you to specify custom labels for each column, instead of just the data value of the column. Additionally, the columns support an image overlay for a unique and custom feel to each chart. Along with several basic formatting options in the format pane, this visual has advanced formatting options located in the advanced edit pane. To access this pane, select the edit option from the ellipsis menu in the top or bottom left of the visual. This will put the visual into focus mode, and display the advanced editing options.
keywords: Definitive Logic PBI Clustered Column Chart with Custom Labels
